# Purpose
This file is a test program for the `fd_gui_live_table_tmpl.c` template. It defines a concrete live table type, `test_live_table`, with three columns: `Pubkey`, `IP Address`, and `Some Metric`. The file also defines row storage, column compare functions, and a fixed scratch buffer used to create the table. The [`main`](<#main>) function checks table size, creates the table, and verifies column name and index lookup functions.

The rest of the file exercises the live table API with insert, remove, update, and sort-key operations.
